:::{#rem-distance-from-origin}
#### Distance from the origin

The distance from the origin $\vzero$ to a vector $\vx$ is the norm of $\vx$:
$d(\vx, \vzero) = \norm{\vx - \vzero} = \norm{\vx}$
[@goodfellow2016deep, p. 39].

For example, the distance from $\vzero$ to $(3, 4)$ is $\norm{(3, 4)} = 5$,
as in @exm-euclidean-norm.

:::
